decontamination_notes: Real feature from python-trio/trio PR #3474, merged 2026-08-11, after model training cutoffs, so the specific implementation is novel. Repo sliced at the PR's base commit 83b96a3 (src/trio + pyproject.toml + Apache/MIT LICENSE). Runs in the per-task image vulcanbench/sandbox:trio-3474 (trio's runtime deps preinstalled, trio imported from the workspace via PYTHONPATH=src). Adds a peak_buffer_used high-water-mark field to MemoryChannelStatistics that does not reset on drain. Hidden tests drive the public open_memory_channel().statistics() API under trio.run and assert the observable peak/current counts, never internal channel state. Tests run with -c /dev/null so the repo's own pytest config/plugins are ignored.
